brief: A minimal, self-hosted workspace: drive, office editing, permissions and spaces for small teams. It should feel solid, modular and calm — the opposite of bloated suites.
criteria: Recognisable at 16 px, one-colour safe, ownable against cloud/folder clichés.

concepts.name: Megaminx Hub
concepts.idea: A twelve-faced megaminx: every face a space, every piece a file, the solid centre is the hub.
rationale: Drive, storage, ERP modules and hub in one geometric object
Dedicated small-size cuts keep it legible at 16 px
Avoids cloud, folder and padlock clichés

recommendation: Megaminx Hub with the constructed lowercase 'pp hub' wordmark.
next_steps: Roll out in app (done: favicon, app icons, BrandMark)
Extend into module icons and patterns
